title: Willie Nelson Melts Fans Over Son, Lukas, Joining Him Onstage, Video - NewsBreak
text:
By Amanda Nowitz ,
1 days ago Willie Nelson cannot be knocked down, and he continues to prove that every time he takes the stage. Recently, he had his son, Lukas, play alongside him, and it melted all of the fans who got to witness the tender moment. Keep reading for the video and all of the sweet reactions.
Willie Nelson Is A Family Man Despite everything, Willie Nelson is a family man. He has been with his wife, Annie, for forty years, and she has been by his side, never letting go. She is his fourth wife, and he has a total of eight children, one of them being Lukas, 37. Lukas is a performer in his own right and has worked with Lady Gaga. However, he has proudly sat next to his father, and did so during the 41st anniversary of Farm Aid. Willie was performing “Help Me Make It Through the Night” with Lukas on guitar.
Willie Nelson- YouTube After fans saw the clip, they were obsessed with the father/son relationship between the men. They gushed over how sweet they were together and how great it was to see them play. Moreover, they loved hearing Lukas’ voice and felt they had a beautiful message :
So great to see them still together on stage! This familiy is so strong together! So beautiful. I love that Willie makes music with his boys- such a loving relationship. You guys are good people! Willie is the best of us . Loved the way Willie looked at his son and smiled when he was playing his guitar.
Willie Nelson has made it clear that he won’t stop performing or touring. He has no idea what he would do with his life if he ever retired. Thankfully, he has so many fans who will continue to show up for him as he tours.
Still Going Strong The one thing that was noted was how Willie Nelson is still going strong. He does not let the fact that he is 93 hold him back. Although he may have had some health struggles in the past, his followers are faithful and love to see him thrive. Unfortunately, they feel that their time with him is coming to an end:
What a gift we have had in Willie Nelson. It makes me sad to know that our time with him is fleeting. It’s always absolutely wonderful to see Willie still performing, but it always makes cry too. Are you a Willie Nelson fan, and do you love seeing him performing with his son? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below.
